userStories.title: Implement recurring transaction generation logic
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to generate recurring transactions on-demand when users navigate to a new month.
acceptanceCriteria: Create generateRecurringTransactionsForMonth(userId, year, month) function
Query all recurring transactions with start_date <= current month
Check if transaction already exists for target month (avoid duplicates)
Generate missing transaction occurrences for the month
Handle monthly frequency: generate if month >= start_date
Handle annual frequency: generate only if month matches start_date month and year >= start_date year
Call generation function when dashboard loads a month
Write unit tests for generation logic
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Created generateRecurringTransactionsForMonth() in src/lib/recurring.ts. Queries recurring transactions with is_recurring=true, frequency in (monthly/annual), and start_date <= target month. For each recurring transaction, determines if should generate based on frequency: monthly generates if year>startYear OR (year==startYear AND month>=startMonth); annual generates only if month==startMonth AND year>=startYear. Checks for duplicates by querying existing transactions matching user_id, type, amount, category in target month date range. Creates new transaction records with same day-of-month as original start_date. Bulk inserts all generated transactions. Integrated into dashboard loadTransactions() - calls generation before querying month's transactions. Created 10 unit tests in src/lib/recurring.test.ts covering monthly/annual logic, date preservation, edge cases. All 24 tests pass (14 calculations + 10 recurring). Typecheck passes.
